addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

attachment.content:
- deep-research: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. - When the user wants a deep, multi-source, fact-checked research report on any topic. BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

# 一期默认异常阈值（来自需求说明第六节）
# 运行时优先此文件；后续可改为飞书配置表覆盖

levels:
  yellow: 观察
  orange: 必须处理
  red: 立即升级

# 工作日：true=仅周一至五计入处理时限
workdays_only: true

rules:
  sales_drop:
    name: 销售下降
    enabled: true
    # 变化幅度为负表示下降；比较「近7天 vs 前7天」类字段（由同步映射提供）
    yellow:
      drop_pct_min: 0.10
      drop_pct_max: 0.20
      baseline_sales_min: 3000
    orange:
      drop_pct_min: 0.20
      baseline_sales_min: 3000
    red:
      # S/A 级下降 >=40%，或核心连续3天无订单（无订单在 engine 另判）
      sa_drop_pct_min: 0.40
      zero_order_days: 3

  order_drop:
    name: 订单下降
    enabled: true
    yellow:
      drop_pct_min: 0.10
      drop_pct_max: 0.25
      baseline_orders_min: 20
    orange:
      drop_pct_min: 0.25
      baseline_orders_min: 20
    red:
      core_drop_pct_min: 0.50
      zero_order_days: 3

  traffic_drop:
    name: 流量下降
    enabled: true
    yellow:
      drop_pct_min: 0.10
      drop_pct_max: 0.20
      baseline_sessions_min: 300
    orange:
      drop_pct_min: 0.20
      baseline_sessions_min: 300
    red:
      core_drop_pct_min: 0.40

  conversion_drop:
    name: 转化下降
    enabled: true
    # 百分点（绝对差），非相对比例
    yellow:
      drop_pp_min: 1.0
      drop_pp_max: 2.0
    orange:
      drop_pp_min: 2.0
      sessions_min: 200
    red:
      drop_pp_min: 4.0

  acos_abnormal:
    name: ACOS异常
    enabled: true
    # 高于目标 ACOS 的百分点；目标来自行字段 target_acos 或默认
    # 试运行：UK 灯泡类先放宽到 35%，红档 20pp（可按品类再拆）
    default_target_acos: 0.35
    min_ad_cost: 10
    yellow:
      over_pp_min: 0.0
      over_pp_max: 5.0
    orange:
      over_pp_min: 5.0
    red:
      over_pp_min: 20.0

  ad_spend_abnormal:
    name: 广告花费异常
    enabled: true
    # 当日花费低于该值不告警（本币，如 GBP）
    min_ad_cost: 20
    yellow:
      spend_up_pct_min: 0.10
      spend_up_pct_max: 0.20
    orange:
      spend_up_pct_min: 0.20
    red:
      spend_up_pct_min: 0.50

  inventory_low:
    name: 库存不足
    enabled: true

    enabled: true
    # 可售天数告警：至少这么多可售件数，避免 0/空库存误报
    min_units: 30

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class Anomaly:
    anomaly_type: str
    name: str
    level: str  # yellow | orange | red
    current_value: float | None
    baseline_value: float | None
    change_value: float | None
    message: str
    shop_name: str
    asin: str
    product_title: str | None = None
    product_title_cn: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    product_grade: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


LEVEL_RANK = {"yellow": 1, "orange": 2, "red": 3}


def _f(v: Any) -> float | None:
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _is_core(grade: str | None, core_grades: list[str]) -> bool:
    if not grade:
        return False
    return str(grade).upper() in {g.upper() for g in core_grades}


def _drop_pct(change_pct: float | None) -> float | None:
    """Normalize to positive drop magnitude if change is negative."""
    if change_pct is None:
        return None
    if change_pct >= 0:
        return None
    return abs(change_pct)


def evaluate_row(row: dict[str, Any], rules_cfg: dict[str, Any]) -> list[Anomaly]:
    rules = rules_cfg.get("rules") or {}
    core_grades = list(rules_cfg.get("core_grades") or ["S", "A"])
    grade = row.get("product_grade")
    core = _is_core(grade, core_grades)
    shop = str(row.get("shop_name") or "")
    asin = str(row.get("asin") or "")
    title = row.get("title")
    title_cn = row.get("title_cn")
    owner = row.get("owner")
    out: list[Anomaly] = []

    def add(
        key: str,
        level: str,
        *,
        current: float | None,
        baseline: float | None,
        change: float | None,
        message: str,
    ) -> None:
        meta = rules.get(key) or {}
        out.append(
            Anomaly(
                anomaly_type=key,
                name=str(meta.get("name") or key),
                level=level,
                current_value=current,
                baseline_value=baseline,
                change_value=change,
                message=message,
                shop_name=shop,
                asin=asin,
                product_title=title,
                product_title_cn=title_cn,
                owner=owner,
                product_grade=grade,
            )
        )

    # --- sales drop ---
    r = rules.get("sales_drop") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        ch = _f(row.get("sale_price_change_pct"))
        drop = _drop_pct(ch)
        base = _f(row.get("sale_price_baseline"))
        cur = _f(row.get("sale_price"))
        orders = _f(row.get("order_num"))
        zero_days = _f(row.get("zero_order_streak"))
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        if core and drop is not None and drop >= float(red.get("sa_drop_pct_min", 0.40)):
            add(
                "sales_drop",
                "red",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"S/A级销售额下降 {drop:.0%}",
            )
        elif orders == 0 and zero_days is not None and zero_days >= float(red.get("zero_order_days", 3)):
            add(
                "sales_drop",
                "red",
                current=orders,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"连续 {int(zero_days)} 天无订单",
            )
        elif (
            drop is not None
            and base is not None
            and base >= float(orange.get("baseline_sales_min", 3000))
            and drop >= float(orange.get("drop_pct_min", 0.20))
        ):
            add(
                "sales_drop",
                "orange",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"销售额下降 {drop:.0%}（基线≥{orange.get('baseline_sales_min')}）",
            )
        elif (
            drop is not None
            and base is not None
            and base >= float(yellow.get("baseline_sales_min", 3000))
            and float(yellow.get("drop_pct_min", 0.10))
            <= drop
            < float(yellow.get("drop_pct_max", 0.20))
        ):
            add(
                "sales_drop",
                "yellow",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"销售额下降观察 {drop:.0%}",
            )

    # --- order drop ---
    r = rules.get("order_drop") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        ch = _f(row.get("order_num_change_pct"))
        drop = _drop_pct(ch)
        base = _f(row.get("order_num_baseline"))
        cur = _f(row.get("order_num"))
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        if core and drop is not None and drop >= float(red.get("core_drop_pct_min", 0.50)):
            add(
                "order_drop",
                "red",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"核心ASIN订单下降 {drop:.0%}",
            )
        elif (
            drop is not None
            and base is not None
            and base >= float(orange.get("baseline_orders_min", 20))
            and drop >= float(orange.get("drop_pct_min", 0.25))
        ):
            add(
                "order_drop",
                "orange",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"订单下降 {drop:.0%}",
            )
        elif (
            drop is not None
            and base is not None
            and base >= float(yellow.get("baseline_orders_min", 20))
            and float(yellow.get("drop_pct_min", 0.10))
            <= drop
            < float(yellow.get("drop_pct_max", 0.25))
        ):
            add(
                "order_drop",
                "yellow",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"订单下降观察 {drop:.0%}",
            )

    # --- traffic ---
    r = rules.get("traffic_drop") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        ch = _f(row.get("sessions_change_pct"))
        drop = _drop_pct(ch)
        base = _f(row.get("sessions_baseline"))
        cur = _f(row.get("sessions"))
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        if core and drop is not None and drop >= float(red.get("core_drop_pct_min", 0.40)):
            add(
                "traffic_drop",
                "red",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"核心ASIN Sessions下降 {drop:.0%}",
            )
        elif (
            drop is not None
            and base is not None
            and base >= float(orange.get("baseline_sessions_min", 300))
            and drop >= float(orange.get("drop_pct_min", 0.20))
        ):
            add(
                "traffic_drop",
                "orange",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"Sessions下降 {drop:.0%}",
            )
        elif (
            drop is not None
            and base is not None
            and base >= float(yellow.get("baseline_sessions_min", 300))
            and float(yellow.get("drop_pct_min", 0.10))
            <= drop
            < float(yellow.get("drop_pct_max", 0.20))
        ):
            add(
                "traffic_drop",
                "yellow",
                current=cur,
                baseline=base,
                change=ch,
                message=f"Sessions下降观察 {drop:.0%}",
            )

    # --- conversion (pp) ---
    r = rules.get("conversion_drop") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        pp = _f(row.get("conversion_rate_change_pp"))
        # negative means drop
        drop_pp = abs(pp) if pp is not None and pp < 0 else None
        sessions = _f(row.get("sessions"))
        cur = _f(row.get("conversion_rate"))
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        if drop_pp is not None and drop_pp >= float(red.get("drop_pp_min", 4.0)):
            add(
                "conversion_drop",
                "red",
                current=cur,
                baseline=None,
                change=pp,
                message=f"转化率下降 {drop_pp:.1f} 个百分点",
            )
        elif (
            drop_pp is not None
            and drop_pp >= float(orange.get("drop_pp_min", 2.0))
            and (sessions is None or sessions >= float(orange.get("sessions_min", 200)))
        ):
            add(
                "conversion_drop",
                "orange",
                current=cur,
                baseline=None,
                change=pp,
                message=f"转化率下降 {drop_pp:.1f} 个百分点",
            )
        elif (
            drop_pp is not None
            and float(yellow.get("drop_pp_min", 1.0))
            <= drop_pp
            < float(yellow.get("drop_pp_max", 2.0))
        ):
            add(
                "conversion_drop",
                "yellow",
                current=cur,
                baseline=None,
                change=pp,
                message=f"转化率下降观察 {drop_pp:.1f}pp",
            )

    # --- acos ---
    r = rules.get("acos_abnormal") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        acos = _f(row.get("acos"))
        ad_cost = _f(row.get("ad_cost")) or 0.0
        min_ad_cost = float(r.get("min_ad_cost") or 0)
        target = _f(row.get("target_acos"))
        if target is None:
            target = float(r.get("default_target_acos") or 0.30)
        # normalize percent vs ratio
        if acos is not None and acos > 1.5:
            acos_r = acos / 100.0
        else:
            acos_r = acos
        if target is not None and target > 1.5:
            target_r = target / 100.0
        else:
            target_r = target
        over_pp = None
        if acos_r is not None and target_r is not None:
            over_pp = (acos_r - target_r) * 100.0
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        if ad_cost < min_ad_cost:
            pass  # 花费过低不告警，避免小样本失真
        elif over_pp is not None and over_pp >= float(red.get("over_pp_min", 15)):
            add(
                "acos_abnormal",
                "red",
                current=acos,
                baseline=target,
                change=over_pp,
                message=f"ACOS 高于目标 {over_pp:.1f}pp",
            )
        elif over_pp is not None and over_pp >= float(orange.get("over_pp_min", 5)):
            add(
                "acos_abnormal",
                "orange",
                current=acos,
                baseline=target,
                change=over_pp,
                message=f"ACOS 高于目标 {over_pp:.1f}pp",
            )
        elif (
            over_pp is not None
            and float(yellow.get("over_pp_min", 0))
            <= over_pp
            < float(yellow.get("over_pp_max", 5))
        ):
            add(
                "acos_abnormal",
                "yellow",
                current=acos,
                baseline=target,
                change=over_pp,
                message=f"ACOS 略高 {over_pp:.1f}pp",
            )

    # --- ad spend ---
    # 仅当同时有花费与广告销售环比数据时判断，避免缺字段时「销售未增」恒为真
    r = rules.get("ad_spend_abnormal") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        ch = _f(row.get("ad_cost_change_pct"))
        up = ch if ch is not None and ch > 0 else None
        ad_sales_ch = _f(row.get("ad_sales_change_pct"))
        cur = _f(row.get("ad_cost"))
        min_cost = float(r.get("min_ad_cost") or 20)
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        if (
            up is not None
            and cur is not None
            and cur >= min_cost
            and ad_sales_ch is not None
            and ad_sales_ch <= 0
        ):
            if up >= float(red.get("spend_up_pct_min", 0.50)):
                add(
                    "ad_spend_abnormal",
                    "red",
                    current=cur,
                    baseline=None,
                    change=ch,
                    message=f"广告花费上涨 {up:.0%} 且广告销售未增",
                )
            elif up >= float(orange.get("spend_up_pct_min", 0.20)):
                add(
                    "ad_spend_abnormal",
                    "orange",
                    current=cur,
                    baseline=None,
                    change=ch,
                    message=f"广告花费上涨 {up:.0%} 且广告销售未增",
                )
            elif float(yellow.get("spend_up_pct_min", 0.10)) <= up < float(
                yellow.get("spend_up_pct_max", 0.20)
            ):
                add(
                    "ad_spend_abnormal",
                    "yellow",
                    current=cur,
                    baseline=None,
                    change=ch,
                    message=f"广告花费上涨观察 {up:.0%}",
                )

    # --- inventory low ---
    # 无动销且库存为 0：视为清仓/下架噪音，默认不报红（require_activity）
    r = rules.get("inventory_low") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        days = _f(row.get("available_days"))
        available = _f(row.get("available"))
        sale_num = _f(row.get("sale_num")) or 0.0
        order_num = _f(row.get("order_num")) or 0.0
        active = sale_num > 0 or order_num > 0
        require_activity = bool(r.get("require_activity", True))
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        # 仅当 available 有值时才判断货，避免脏数据
        stockout = available is not None and available <= 0
        if require_activity and not active:
            pass  # 无动销：不足库存不建任务
        elif stockout:
            add(
                "inventory_low",
                "red",
                current=available,
                baseline=None,
                change=None,
                message="FBA可售为0（断货）",
            )
        elif (
            days is not None
            and available is not None
            and available > 0
            and days <= float(red.get("days_max", 7))
        ):
            add(
                "inventory_low",
                "red",
                current=days,
                baseline=None,
                change=None,
                message=f"可售天数≤{red.get('days_max', 7)}天且仍有动销",
            )
        elif (
            days is not None
            and available is not None
            and available > 0
            and float(orange.get("days_min", 15)) <= days < float(orange.get("days_max", 30))
        ):
            add(
                "inventory_low",
                "orange",
                current=days,
                baseline=None,
                change=None,
                message=f"可售天数 {days:.0f}",
            )
        elif (
            days is not None
            and available is not None
            and available > 0
            and float(yellow.get("days_min", 30)) <= days < float(yellow.get("days_max", 45))
        ):
            add(
                "inventory_low",
                "yellow",
                current=days,
                baseline=None,
                change=None,
                message=f"可售天数观察 {days:.0f}",
            )

    # --- inventory high ---
    r = rules.get("inventory_high") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        days = _f(row.get("available_days"))
        age = _f(row.get("inv_age_365_plus"))
        available = _f(row.get("available")) or 0.0
        sale_num = _f(row.get("sale_num")) or 0.0
        order_num = _f(row.get("order_num")) or 0.0
        active = sale_num > 0 or order_num > 0
        min_units = float(r.get("min_units") or 20)
        require_activity = bool(r.get("require_activity", True))
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        age_qty_min = float(red.get("age_qty_min") or 1)
        min_units_for_age = float(red.get("min_units_for_age") or 5)

        # 库龄红：有一定库存且 365+ 件数达到阈值（不要求当日动销）
        if (
            age is not None
            and age >= age_qty_min
            and available >= min_units_for_age
        ):
            add(
                "inventory_high",
                "red",
                current=age,
                baseline=None,
                change=None,
                message=f"365+库龄件数 {age:.0f}",
            )
        elif available < min_units:
            pass
        elif require_activity and not active:
            pass  # 无动销的高可售天数：一期不建橙/黄任务，减少噪音
        elif days is not None and days > float(orange.get("days_min", 180)):
            add(
                "inventory_high",
                "orange",
                current=days,
                baseline=None,
                change=None,
                message=f"可售天数过高 {days:.0f}",
            )
        elif days is not None and float(yellow.get("days_min", 120)) <= days <= float(
            yellow.get("days_max", 180)
        ):
            add(
                "inventory_high",
                "yellow",
                current=days,
                baseline=None,
                change=None,
                message=f"可售天数偏高 {days:.0f}",
            )

    # --- review ---
    r = rules.get("review_abnormal") or {}
    if r.get("enabled", True):
        rating = _f(row.get("rating"))
        rating_ch = _f(row.get("rating_change"))
        low = _f(row.get("low_review_num"))
        yellow = r.get("yellow") or {}
        orange = r.get("orange") or {}
        red = r.get("red") or {}
        drop = abs(rating_ch) if rating_ch is not None and rating_ch < 0 else None
        # 无评价数据时不告警
        if rating is None and low is None and rating_ch is None:
            pass
        elif rating is not None and rating < float(red.get("rating_floor", 3.5)):
            add(
                "review_abnormal",
                "red",
                current=rating,
                baseline=None,
                change=rating_ch,
                message=f"星级跌破 {red.get('rating_floor')}: {rating}",
            )
        elif (drop is not None and drop >= float(orange.get("rating_drop_min", 0.2))) or (
            low is not None and low >= float(orange.get("low_star_7d_min", 3))
        ):
            add(
                "review_abnormal",
                "orange",
                current=rating,
                baseline=None,
                change=rating_ch,
                message="星级明显下降或中差评增多",
            )
        elif (drop is not None and drop >= float(yellow.get("rating_drop_min", 0.1))) or (
            low is not None and low >= float(yellow.get("low_star_count_min", 1))
        ):
            add(
                "review_abnormal",
                "yellow",
                current=rating,
                baseline=None,
                change=rating_ch,
                message="评价异常观察",
            )

    return out


def _enrich_from_raw(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """从 raw_json 补齐库表未落库的辅助字段（如广告销售环比）。"""
    out = dict(row)
    raw = row.get("raw_json")
    if isinstance(raw, str) and raw:
        import json

        try:
            raw = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            raw = None
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return out
    fm = raw.get("fieldsMap") if isinstance(raw.get("fieldsMap"), dict) else {}

    def mom_pct(key: str) -> float | None:
        node = fm.get(key) if isinstance(fm.get(key), dict) else {}
        p = _f(node.get("momPercent"))
        return None if p is None else p / 100.0

    if out.get("ad_sales_change_pct") is None:
        out["ad_sales_change_pct"] = mom_pct("adTotalSale") or mom_pct(
            "adSalePriceDirectTotal"
        )
    if out.get("sale_price_baseline") is None:
        node = fm.get("salePrice") if isinstance(fm.get("salePrice"), dict) else {}
        out["sale_price_baseline"] = _f(node.get("momValue"))
    if out.get("order_num_baseline") is None:
        node = fm.get("orderNum") if isinstance(fm.get("orderNum"), dict) else {}
        out["order_num_baseline"] = _f(node.get("momValue"))
    if out.get("sessions_baseline") is None:
        node = fm.get("sessions") if isinstance(fm.get("sessions"), dict) else {}
        out["sessions_baseline"] = _f(node.get("momValue"))
    return out


def evaluate_rows(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]], rules_cfg: dict[str, Any]
) -> list[Anomaly]:
    anomalies: list[Anomaly] = []
    for row in rows:
        anomalies.extend(evaluate_row(_enrich_from_raw(row), rules_cfg))
    return anomalies


def highest_level(anomalies: list[Anomaly]) -> str | None:
    if not anomalies:
        return None
    return max(anomalies, key=lambda a: LEVEL_RANK.get(a.level, 0)).level

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

from app.config import get_app_config
from app.rules.engine import Anomaly
from app.store.db import Database

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _due_at(level: str, workdays_only: bool = True) -> str:
    """Orange: 1 workday; Red: same calendar day end."""
    now = _utc_now()
    if level == "red":
        due = now.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=0, microsecond=0)
        return due.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    # orange default: +1 workday
    d = now
    add = 1
    while add > 0:
        d = d + timedelta(days=1)
        if not workdays_only or d.weekday() < 5:
            add -= 1
    return d.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def apply_anomalies_to_tasks(
    anomalies: list[Anomaly],
    *,
    biz_date: str,
    db: Database,
    rules_cfg: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Create/update tasks for orange/red; yellow only counted."""
    cfg = get_app_config()
    reviewers = cfg.get("reviewers") or {}
    default_reviewer = reviewers.get("default")
    workdays_only = True
    if rules_cfg:
        workdays_only = bool(rules_cfg.get("workdays_only", True))

    stats = {"yellow": 0, "orange_new": 0, "orange_updated": 0, "red_new": 0, "red_updated": 0, "skipped": 0}

    for a in anomalies:
        if a.level == "yellow":
            stats["yellow"] += 1
            continue
        if a.level not in ("orange", "red"):
            stats["skipped"] += 1
            continue

        existing = db.get_open_task(a.shop_name, a.asin, a.anomaly_type)
        reviewer = default_reviewer
        if existing:
            streak = int(existing.get("streak") or 1) + 1
            task_id = existing["task_id"]
            # escalate level if worse
            level = a.level
            if existing.get("level") == "red":
                level = "red"
            task = {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "biz_date": biz_date,
                "shop_name": a.shop_name,
                "asin": a.asin,
                "product_title": a.product_title,
                "product_title_cn": a.product_title_cn
                or existing.get("product_title_cn"),
                "anomaly_type": a.anomaly_type,
                "level": level,
                "current_value": a.current_value,
                "baseline_value": a.baseline_value,
                "change_value": a.change_value,
                "owner": a.owner or existing.get("owner"),
                "reviewer": existing.get("reviewer") or reviewer,
                "status": existing.get("status") or "open",
                "due_at": existing.get("due_at") or _due_at(level, workdays_only),
                "streak": streak,
                "need_boss": 1 if level == "red" else int(existing.get("need_boss") or 0),
                "payload_json": a.to_dict(),
                "created_at": existing.get("created_at"),
            }
            db.upsert_task(task)
            stats[f"{a.level}_updated"] = stats.get(f"{a.level}_updated", 0) + 1
        else:
            task_id = f"T{biz_date.replace('-', '')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}"
            task = {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "biz_date": biz_date,
                "shop_name": a.shop_name,
                "asin": a.asin,
                "product_title": a.product_title,
                "product_title_cn": a.product_title_cn,
                "anomaly_type": a.anomaly_type,
                "level": a.level,
                "current_value": a.current_value,
                "baseline_value": a.baseline_value,
                "change_value": a.change_value,
                "owner": a.owner,
                "reviewer": reviewer,
                "status": "open",
                "due_at": _due_at(a.level, workdays_only),
                "streak": 1,
                "need_boss": 1 if a.level == "red" else 0,
                "payload_json": a.to_dict(),
            }
            db.upsert_task(task)
            stats[f"{a.level}_new"] = stats.get(f"{a.level}_new", 0) + 1

    logger.info("Tasks applied: %s", stats)
    return stats

        "主键": action_pk_for_task(task_id),
        "关联异常编号": task_id,
        "店铺": task.get("shop_name"),
        "ASIN": task.get("asin"),
        "中文名称": title_cn or None,
        "异常类型": task.get("anomaly_type"),
        "等级": task.get("level"),
        "是否属实": "待核实",
        "判断依据": "；".join(hint_parts),
        "执行日期": _biz_date_ts(str(task.get("biz_date") or ""))
        if task.get("biz_date")
        else None,
        "执行人": task.get("owner"),
        "闭环状态": "待核实",
    }


# --- 每日汇总 ---
def _biz_date_ts(biz_date: str) -> int:
    """将 'YYYY-MM-DD' 转为毫秒 Unix 时间戳（飞书日期字段格式）。"""
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    dt = datetime.strptime(biz_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
    return int(dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1000)


def summary_to_fields(agg: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """将 aggregate_daily_summary 结果转为飞书每日汇总表 fields。"""
    return {
        "主键": agg.get("biz_date"),
        "日期": _biz_date_ts(agg.get("biz_date") or ""),
        "店铺数": agg.get("shop_count"),
        "ASIN总数": agg.get("asin_count"),

    }

    notify = cfg.get("notify") or {}
    base = (notify.get("view_base_url") or "").rstrip("?&")
    if not base and settings.feishu_bitable_app_token:
        base = f"https://dcnkj1up67d5.feishu.cn/base/{settings.feishu_bitable_app_token}"
    tasks_url = base
    actions_url = base
    if settings.feishu_table_tasks:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base else "?"
        tasks_url = f"{base}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_tasks}"
    if settings.feishu_table_actions:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base else "?"
        actions_url = f"{base}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_actions}"
    return tasks_url, actions_url

    owner: str,

    )

    # 卡片颜色

from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from app.rules.engine import evaluate_row
from app.rules.tasks import apply_anomalies_to_tasks
from app.store.db import Database


def load_rules():
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "config" / "rules.default.yaml"
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f)


def test_sales_drop_orange():
    rules = load_rules()
    row = {
        "shop_name": "特米",
        "asin": "B0TESTORANGE",
        "title": "demo",
        "product_grade": "B",
        "sale_price": 7000,
        "sale_price_baseline": 10000,
        "sale_price_change_pct": -0.30,
        "order_num": 50,
    }
    anomalies = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    sales = [a for a in anomalies if a.anomaly_type == "sales_drop"]
    assert sales, anomalies
    assert sales[0].level == "orange"


def test_sales_drop_red_for_sa():
    rules = load_rules()
    row = {
        "shop_name": "特米",
        "asin": "B0TESTRED",
        "title": "core",
        "product_grade": "S",
        "sale_price": 5000,
        "sale_price_baseline": 10000,
        "sale_price_change_pct": -0.45,
    }
    anomalies = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    sales = [a for a in anomalies if a.anomaly_type == "sales_drop"]
    assert sales and sales[0].level == "red"


def test_inventory_low_red_stockout():
    rules = load_rules()

import json
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterator


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


class Database:
    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._init_schema()

    @contextmanager
    def connect(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.path)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        try:
            yield conn
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            conn.close()

    def _init_schema(self) -> None:
        with self.connect() as conn:
            conn.executescript(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kv (
                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    value TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
                );

                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_runs (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    biz_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    finished_at TEXT,
                    total_rows INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

3. 应用已发布/可用，并将应用添加为多维表格协作者（创建后脚本会输出 app_token）
4. .env 已填 FEISHU_APP_ID / FEISHU_APP_SECRET

用法：
  python scripts/init_feishu_tables.py
  python scripts/init_feishu_tables.py --name "ASIN健康度驾驶舱"
  python scripts/init_feishu_tables.py --app-token bascnXXXX   # 已有多维表时只建子表
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient, FeishuError
from app.config import get_settings
from app.sync.feishu_schema import TABLE_SPECS


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="初始化飞书多维表")
    parser.add_argument("--name", default="ASIN健康度监控", help="新建多维表格名称")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--app-token",
        default="",
        help="已有多维表格 app_token；不填则新建",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--folder-token",
        default="",
        help="可选：创建到指定云空间文件夹",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.has_feishu:
        print("ERROR: 请在 .env 配置 FEISHU_APP_ID / FEISHU_APP_SECRET")
        return 2

    try:
        with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
            app_token = args.app_token.strip()
            if not app_token:
                print(f"创建多维表格: {args.name} ...")
                created = client.create_bitable_app(
                    args.name,
                    folder_token=args.folder_token or None,
                )
                # 响应结构: data.app.app_token 或 data.app_token
                app = created.get("app") if isinstance(created.get("app"), dict) else created
                app_token = (
                    app.get("app_token")
                    or created.get("app_token")
                    or ""
                )
                if not app_token:
                    print("创建返回无 app_token:", created)
                    return 1
                print(f"OK app_token={app_token}")
                url = app.get("url") or created.get("url")
                if url:
                    print(f"URL: {url}")
            else:
                print(f"使用已有 app_token={app_token}")
                tables = client.list_tables(app_token)
                print(f"已有子表 {len(tables)} 个:", [t.get("name") for t in tables])

            existing = {
                t.get("name"): t.get("table_id")
                for t in client.list_tables(app_token)
            }

def test_inventory_low_red_stockout():
    rules = load_rules()
    # 有动销 + 断货才报红；无动销断货默认跳过
    row = {
        "shop_name": "NOTTAC",
        "asin": "B0STOCKOUT",
        "available": 0,
        "available_days": 0,
        "sale_num": 5,
        "order_num": 3,
    }
    anomalies = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    inv = [a for a in anomalies if a.anomaly_type == "inventory_low"]
    assert inv and inv[0].level == "red"
    assert inv[0].current_value == 0


def test_inventory_low_skip_inactive_stockout():
    rules = load_rules()
    row = {
        "shop_name": "NOTTAC",
        "asin": "B0INACTIVE",
        "available": 0,
        "available_days": 0,
        "sale_num": 0,
        "order_num": 0,
    }
    anomalies = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    inv = [a for a in anomalies if a.anomaly_type == "inventory_low"]
    assert not inv


def test_inventory_high_skip_inactive_long_days():
    rules = load_rules()
    row = {
        "shop_name": "特米-UK",
        "asin": "B0HIGH",
        "available": 100,
        "available_days": 400,
        "sale_num": 0,
        "order_num": 0,
        "inv_age_365_plus": 0,
    }
    anomalies = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    inv = [a for a in anomalies if a.anomaly_type == "inventory_high"]
    assert not inv


def test_inventory_high_orange_when_active():
    rules = load_rules()
    row = {
        "shop_name": "特米-UK",
        "asin": "B0HIGH2",
        "available": 100,
        "available_days": 400,
        "sale_num": 10,
        "order_num": 5,
        "inv_age_365_plus": 0,
    }
    anomalies = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    inv = [a for a in anomalies if a.anomaly_type == "inventory_high"]
    assert inv and inv[0].level == "orange"


def test_inventory_high_not_orange_under_240_days():
    rules = load_rules()
    row = {
        "shop_name": "特米-UK",
        "asin": "B0MID",
        "available": 100,
        "available_days": 200,
        "sale_num": 10,
        "order_num": 5,
        "inv_age_365_plus": 0,
    }
    anomalies = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    inv = [a for a in anomalies if a.anomaly_type == "inventory_high"]
    # 200 天落在 yellow 180-240
    assert inv and inv[0].level == "yellow"


def test_task_dedup(tmp_path):
    rules = load_rules()
    db = Database(tmp_path / "t.db")
    row = {
        "shop_name": "特米",
        "asin": "B0DEDUP",
        "title": "x",
        "product_grade": "B",
        "sale_price": 7000,
        "sale_price_baseline": 10000,
        "sale_price_change_pct": -0.30,
        "owner": "潘启豪",
    }
    a1 = evaluate_row(row, rules)
    s1 = apply_anomalies_to_tasks(a1, biz_date="2026-07-20", db=db, rules_cfg=rules)
    s2 = apply_anomalies_to_tasks(a1, biz_date="2026-07-21", db=db, rules_cfg=rules)
    tasks = db.list_tasks()
    open_sales = [
        t
        for t in tasks
        if t["asin"] == "B0DEDUP" and t["anomaly_type"] == "sales_drop"
    ]
    assert len(open_sales) == 1
    assert open_sales[0]["streak"] >= 2
    assert s1["orange_new"] + s1["red_new"] >= 1
    assert s2["orange_updated"] + s2["red_updated"] >= 1

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any, Literal


@dataclass
class Anomaly:
    anomaly_type: str
    name: str
    level: str  # yellow | orange | red
    current_value: float | None
    baseline_value: float | None
    change_value: float | None
    message: str
    shop_name: str
    asin: str
    product_title: str | None = None
    product_title_cn: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    product_grade: str | None = None
    # 指标语义：不同异常类型下「当前值/对比值/变化幅度」含义不同
    current_label: str | None = None
    baseline_label: str | None = None
    change_label: str | None = None
    value_summary: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


LEVEL_RANK = {"yellow": 1, "orange": 2, "red": 3}

Fmt = Literal["raw", "pct", "pp", "days", "units", "money", "rating", "ratio_or_pct"]


def _f(v: Any) -> float | None:
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _is_core(grade: str | None, core_grades: list[str]) -> bool:
    if not grade:
        return False
    return str(grade).upper() in {g.upper() for g in core_grades}


def _drop_pct(change_pct: float | None) -> float | None:
    """Normalize to positive drop magnitude if change is negative."""
    if change_pct is None:
        return None
    if change_pct >= 0:
        return None
    return abs(change_pct)


def _fmt_value(v: float | None, style: Fmt = "raw") -> str:
    if v is None:
        return "—"
    if style == "pct":
        # 入库多为小数环比（-0.3）；>1.5 视为已是百分数
        if abs(v) <= 2:
            return f"{v:+.0%}" if v != 0 else "0%"
        return f"{v:+.1f}%"
    if style == "pp":
        return f"{v:+.1f}pp"
    if style == "days":
        return f"{v:.1f}天" if abs(v - round(v)) > 1e-6 else f"{int(round(v))}天"
    if style == "units":
        return f"{v:.0f}件"
    if style == "money":
        return f"{v:.1f}"
    if style == "rating":
        return f"{v:.2f}"
    if style == "ratio_or_pct":
        # ACOS：0.35 或 35 都能读
        if abs(v) <= 1.5:
            return f"{v:.1%}"
        return f"{v:.1f}%"
    if abs(v - round(v)) < 1e-6:
        return str(int(round(v)))
    return f"{v:.2f}"


def build_value_summary(
    *,
    current: float | None,
    baseline: float | None,
    change: float | None,
    current_label: str | None,
    baseline_label: str | None,
    change_label: str | None,
    current_fmt: Fmt = "raw",
    baseline_fmt: Fmt = "raw",
    change_fmt: Fmt = "raw",
) -> str:
    """一行可读摘要，例如：可售天数 1.6天 | ACOS 105.5% vs 目标 35%（超 70.5pp）。"""
    parts: list[str] = []
    if current_label and current is not None:
        parts.append(f"{current_label} {_fmt_value(current, current_fmt)}")
    elif current is not None:
        parts.append(_fmt_value(current, current_fmt))
    if baseline_label and baseline is not None:
        parts.append(f"{baseline_label} {_fmt_value(baseline, baseline_fmt)}")
    elif baseline is not None:
        parts.append(f"对比 {_fmt_value(baseline, baseline_fmt)}")
    if change_label and change is not None:
        parts.append(f"{change_label} {_fmt_value(change, change_fmt)}")
    elif change is not None:
        parts.append(f"变化 {_fmt_value(change, change_fmt)}")
    return " · ".join(parts) if parts else ""


def evaluate_row(row: dict[str, Any], rules_cfg: dict[str, Any]) -> list[Anomaly]:
    rules = rules_cfg.get("rules") or {}
    core_grades = list(rules_cfg.get("core_grades") or ["S", "A"])
    grade = row.get("product_grade")
    core = _is_core(grade, core_grades)
    shop = str(row.get("shop_name") or "")
    asin = str(row.get("asin") or "")
    title = row.get("title")
    title_cn = row.get("title_cn")
    owner = row.get("owner")
    out: list[Anomaly] = []

    def add(
        key: str,
        level: str,
        *,
        current: float | None,
        baseline: float | None,
        change: float | None,
        message: str,
        current_label: str | None = None,
        baseline_label: str | None = None,
        change_label: str | None = None,
        current_fmt: Fmt = "raw",
        baseline_fmt: Fmt = "raw",
        change_fmt: Fmt = "raw",
    ) -> None:
        meta = rules.get(key) or {}
        summary = build_value_summary(
            current=current,
            baseline=baseline,
            change=change,
            current_label=current_label,
            baseline_label=baseline_label,
            change_label=change_label,
            current_fmt=current_fmt,
            baseline_fmt=baseline_fmt,
            change_fmt=change_fmt,
        )
        out.append(
            Anomaly(
                anomaly_type=key,
                name=str(meta.get("name") or key),
                level=level,
                current_value=current,
                baseline_value=baseline,
                change_value=change,
                message=message,
                shop_name=shop,
                asin=asin,
                product_title=title,
                product_title_cn=title_cn,
                owner=owner,
                product_grade=grade,
                current_label=current_label,
                baseline_label=baseline_label,
                change_label=change_label,
                value_summary=summary or None,
            )
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

from app.config import get_app_config
from app.rules.engine import Anomaly
from app.store.db import Database

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _due_at(level: str, workdays_only: bool = True) -> str:
    """Orange: 1 workday; Red: same calendar day end."""
    now = _utc_now()
    if level == "red":
        due = now.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=0, microsecond=0)
        return due.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    # orange default: +1 workday
    d = now
    add = 1
    while add > 0:
        d = d + timedelta(days=1)
        if not workdays_only or d.weekday() < 5:
            add -= 1
    return d.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def apply_anomalies_to_tasks(
    anomalies: list[Anomaly],
    *,
    biz_date: str,
    db: Database,
    rules_cfg: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Create/update tasks for orange/red; yellow only counted."""
    cfg = get_app_config()
    reviewers = cfg.get("reviewers") or {}
    default_reviewer = reviewers.get("default")
    workdays_only = True
    if rules_cfg:
        workdays_only = bool(rules_cfg.get("workdays_only", True))

    stats = {"yellow": 0, "orange_new": 0, "orange_updated": 0, "red_new": 0, "red_updated": 0, "skipped": 0}

    for a in anomalies:
        if a.level == "yellow":
            stats["yellow"] += 1
            continue
        if a.level not in ("orange", "red"):
            stats["skipped"] += 1
            continue

        existing = db.get_open_task(a.shop_name, a.asin, a.anomaly_type)
        reviewer = default_reviewer
        if existing:
            streak = int(existing.get("streak") or 1) + 1
            task_id = existing["task_id"]
            # escalate level if worse
            level = a.level
            if existing.get("level") == "red":
                level = "red"
            task = {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "biz_date": biz_date,
                "shop_name": a.shop_name,
                "asin": a.asin,
                "product_title": a.product_title,
                "product_title_cn": a.product_title_cn
                or existing.get("product_title_cn"),
                "anomaly_type": a.anomaly_type,
                "level": level,
                "current_value": a.current_value,
                "baseline_value": a.baseline_value,
                "change_value": a.change_value,
                "owner": a.owner or existing.get("owner"),
                "reviewer": existing.get("reviewer") or reviewer,
                "status": existing.get("status") or "open",
                "due_at": existing.get("due_at") or _due_at(level, workdays_only),
                "streak": streak,
                "need_boss": 1 if level == "red" else int(existing.get("need_boss") or 0),
                "payload_json": a.to_dict(),
                "created_at": existing.get("created_at"),
            }
            db.upsert_task(task)
            stats[f"{a.level}_updated"] = stats.get(f"{a.level}_updated", 0) + 1
        else:
            task_id = f"T{biz_date.replace('-', '')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}"
            task = {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "biz_date": biz_date,
                "shop_name": a.shop_name,
                "asin": a.asin,
                "product_title": a.product_title,
                "product_title_cn": a.product_title_cn,
                "anomaly_type": a.anomaly_type,
                "level": a.level,

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

from app.config import get_app_config
from app.rules.engine import Anomaly
from app.store.db import Database

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _due_at(level: str, workdays_only: bool = True) -> str:
    """Orange: 1 workday; Red: same calendar day end."""
    now = _utc_now()
    if level == "red":
        due = now.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=0, microsecond=0)
        return due.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    # orange default: +1 workday
    d = now
    add = 1
    while add > 0:
        d = d + timedelta(days=1)
        if not workdays_only or d.weekday() < 5:
            add -= 1
    return d.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def apply_anomalies_to_tasks(
    anomalies: list[Anomaly],
    *,
    biz_date: str,
    db: Database,
    rules_cfg: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Create/update tasks for orange/red; yellow only counted."""
    cfg = get_app_config()
    reviewers = cfg.get("reviewers") or {}
    default_reviewer = reviewers.get("default")
    workdays_only = True
    if rules_cfg:
        workdays_only = bool(rules_cfg.get("workdays_only", True))

    stats = {"yellow": 0, "orange_new": 0, "orange_updated": 0, "red_new": 0, "red_updated": 0, "skipped": 0}

    for a in anomalies:
        if a.level == "yellow":
            stats["yellow"] += 1
            continue
        if a.level not in ("orange", "red"):
            stats["skipped"] += 1
            continue

        existing = db.get_open_task(a.shop_name, a.asin, a.anomaly_type)
        reviewer = default_reviewer
        if existing:
            streak = int(existing.get("streak") or 1) + 1
            task_id = existing["task_id"]
            # escalate level if worse
            level = a.level
            if existing.get("level") == "red":
                level = "red"
            task = {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "biz_date": biz_date,
                "shop_name": a.shop_name,
                "asin": a.asin,
                "product_title": a.product_title,
                "product_title_cn": a.product_title_cn
                or existing.get("product_title_cn"),
                "anomaly_type": a.anomaly_type,
                "level": level,
                "current_value": a.current_value,
                "baseline_value": a.baseline_value,
                "change_value": a.change_value,
                "current_label": a.current_label,
                "baseline_label": a.baseline_label,
                "change_label": a.change_label,
                "value_summary": a.value_summary,
                "message": a.message,
                "owner": a.owner or existing.get("owner"),
                "reviewer": existing.get("reviewer") or reviewer,
                "status": existing.get("status") or "open",
                "due_at": existing.get("due_at") or _due_at(level, workdays_only),
                "streak": streak,
                "need_boss": 1 if level == "red" else int(existing.get("need_boss") or 0),
                "payload_json": a.to_dict(),
                "created_at": existing.get("created_at"),
            }
            db.upsert_task(task)
            stats[f"{a.level}_updated"] = stats.get(f"{a.level}_updated", 0) + 1
        else:
            task_id = f"T{biz_date.replace('-', '')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}"
            task = {
                "task_id": task_id,
                "biz_date": biz_date,
                "shop_name": a.shop_name,
                "asin": a.asin,
                "product_title": a.product_title,
                "product_title_cn": a.product_title_cn,
                "anomaly_type": a.anomaly_type,
                "level": a.level,
                "current_value": a.current_value,
                "baseline_value": a.baseline_value,
                "change_value": a.change_value,
                "owner": a.owner,
                "reviewer": reviewer,
                "status": "open",
                "due_at": _due_at(a.level, workdays_only),
                "streak": 1,
                "need_boss": 1 if a.level == "red" else 0,
                "payload_json": a.to_dict(),
            }
            db.upsert_task(task)
            stats[f"{a.level}_new"] = stats.get(f"{a.level}_new", 0) + 1

    logger.info("Tasks applied: %s", stats)
    return stats

"""按负责人推送异常任务（群 webhook；交互式卡片 + @）。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json as _json
import logging
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any

from app.config import Settings, get_app_config, get_settings
from app.store.db import Database

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _owner_open_ids(cfg: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
    notify = cfg.get("notify") or {}
    raw = notify.get("owner_open_ids") or {}
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return {}
    return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in raw.items() if k and v}


def _view_urls(cfg: dict[str, Any], settings: Settings) -> tuple[str, str]:
    notify = cfg.get("notify") or {}
    base = (notify.get("view_base_url") or "").rstrip("?&")
    if not base and settings.feishu_bitable_app_token:
        base = f"https://dcnkj1up67d5.feishu.cn/base/{settings.feishu_bitable_app_token}"
    tasks_url = base
    actions_url = base
    if settings.feishu_table_tasks:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base else "?"
        tasks_url = f"{base}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_tasks}"
    if settings.feishu_table_actions:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base else "?"
        actions_url = f"{base}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_actions}"
    return tasks_url, actions_url


def _build_owner_card(
    owner: str,
    items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    biz_date: str,
    tasks_url: str,
    actions_url: str,
    open_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """为单个负责人构建交互式卡片。"""
    from app.clients.feishu import (
        card_action,
        card_button,
        card_header,
        card_hr,
        card_md,
    )

    red = [t for t in items if t.get("level") == "red"]
    orange = [t for t in items if t.get("level") == "orange"]
    ordered = sorted(
        items,
        key=lambda x: (0 if x.get("level") == "red" else 1, x.get("shop_name") or ""),
    )

    # 卡片颜色
    card_color = "red" if red else "orange"

    # @ 提及
    at_line = ""
    if open_id:
        at_line = f"<at id={open_id}></at>\n"

    md_lines = [
        f"{at_line}📅 **{biz_date}** 待你处理",
        "",
        f"👤 **{owner}** | 🔴 {len(red)} | 🟠 {len(orange)}",
        "",
        "> 请打开「运营动作记录」补全：是否属实 / 原因 / 采取动作 / 复查日期",
        "",
    ]
    for t in ordered[:8]:
        icon = "🔴" if t.get("level") == "red" else "🟠"
        cn = t.get("product_title_cn") or t.get("product_title") or ""
        cn_s = f" {cn}" if cn else ""
        md_lines.append(
            f"{icon} `{t.get('task_id')}` {t.get('shop_name')} {t.get('asin')}{cn_s}"
            f" | {t.get('anomaly_type')}"
        )
    if len(ordered) > 8:
        md_lines.append(f"…另有 {len(ordered) - 8} 条，见任务表")

    elements = [
        card_md("\n".join(md_lines)),
        card_hr(),
        card_action(
            card_button("📝 打开动作表", actions_url, primary=True),
            card_button("📋 查看任务表", tasks_url),
        ),
    ]

    title = f"{'🔴' if red else '🟠'} 待你处理 · {biz_date}"
    return {
        **card_header(title, color=card_color),
        "elements": elements,
    }


def build_owner_messages(
    tasks: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    biz_date: str,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """返回 [{owner, text, card, open_id, red, orange, count}, ...]。"""
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    cfg = get_app_config()
    open_ids = _owner_open_ids(cfg)
    tasks_url, actions_url = _view_urls(cfg, settings)

    by_owner: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for t in tasks:
        if t.get("status") in ("closed", "resolved"):
            continue
        if t.get("level") not in ("red", "orange"):
            continue
        owner = str(t.get("owner") or "未分配")
        by_owner[owner].append(t)

    messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for owner, items in sorted(by_owner.items()):
        red = [t for t in items if t.get("level") == "red"]
        orange = [t for t in items if t.get("level") == "orange"]
        ordered = sorted(
            items,
            key=lambda x: (0 if x.get("level") == "red" else 1, x.get("shop_name") or ""),
        )
        # 保留纯文本 fallback
        lines = [
            f"【ASIN健康度】{biz_date} 待你处理",
            f"负责人: {owner} | 红 {len(red)} | 橙 {len(orange)}",
            "",
            "请打开「运营动作记录」补全：是否属实 / 原因 / 采取动作 / 复查日期",
            f"动作表: {actions_url}",
            f"任务表: {tasks_url}",
            "",
        ]
        for t in ordered[:12]:
            cn = t.get("product_title_cn") or t.get("product_title") or ""
            cn_s = f" {cn}" if cn else ""
            lines.append(
                f"· [{t.get('level')}] {t.get('shop_name')} {t.get('asin')}{cn_s} "
                f"| {t.get('anomaly_type')} | 编号 {t.get('task_id')}"
            )
        if len(ordered) > 12:
            lines.append(f"· …另有 {len(ordered) - 12} 条，见任务表")

        card = _build_owner_card(
            owner, items, biz_date, tasks_url, actions_url, open_ids.get(owner)
        )

        messages.append(
            {
                "owner": owner,
                "text": "\n".join(lines),
                "card": card,
                "open_id": open_ids.get(owner),
                "red": len(red),
                "orange": len(orange),
                "count": len(items),
            }
        )
    return messages


def push_tasks_to_owners(
    db: Database,
    biz_date: str,
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    only_new: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """按负责人拆分推送。only_new=True 时仅推当日新建（streak==1）任务。"""
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    tasks = [
        t
        for t in db.list_tasks(biz_date=biz_date)
        if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")
        and t.get("level") in ("red", "orange")
    ]
    if only_new:
        tasks = [t for t in tasks if int(t.get("streak") or 1) <= 1]

    messages = build_owner_messages(tasks, biz_date=biz_date, settings=settings)
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "owners": len(messages),
        "tasks": len(tasks),
        "sent": 0,
        "dry_run": dry_run,
        "details": [],
    }

    webhook = (settings.feishu_bot_webhook or "").strip()
    for msg in messages:
        detail = {
            "owner": msg["owner"],
            "count": msg["count"],
            "red": msg["red"],
            "orange": msg["orange"],
            "at": bool(msg.get("open_id")),
        }
        db.log_notify(
            "owner_push",
            {
                "biz_date": biz_date,
                "owner": msg["owner"],
                "text": msg["text"],
                "card": msg["card"],
                "task_count": msg["count"],
            },
        )
        if dry_run:
            logger.info(
                "owner_push dry-run %s:\nCard:\n%s",
                msg["owner"],
                _json.dumps(msg["card"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            )
            detail["status"] = "dry_run"
            result["details"].append(detail)
            continue
        if not webhook:
            logger.warning("未配置 FEISHU_BOT_WEBHOOK，负责人推送仅写 notify_log")
            detail["status"] = "logged_only"
            result["details"].append(detail)
            continue
        try:
            from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient

            # 优先发卡片
            card_sent = False
            if settings.has_feishu:
                try:
                    with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
                        client.send_webhook_card(msg["card"], webhook=webhook)
                    card_sent = True
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception("卡片发送失败，回退文本")
            else:
                # 直接 httpx 发卡片
                try:
                    import httpx
                    resp = httpx.post(
                        webhook,
                        json={"msg_type": "interactive", "card": msg["card"]},
                        timeout=30,
                    )
                    resp.raise_for_status()
                    card_sent = True
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception("httpx 卡片发送失败，回退文本")

            if not card_sent:
                # 回退纯文本
                if settings.has_feishu:
                    with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
                        client.send_webhook_text_with_at(
                            msg["text"],
                            at_open_ids=[msg["open_id"]] if msg.get("open_id") else None,
                            webhook=webhook,
                        )
                else:
                    import httpx
                    text = msg["text"]
                    if msg.get("open_id"):
                        text = f'<at user_id="{msg["open_id"]}"></at>\n{text}'
                    resp = httpx.post(
                        webhook,
                        json={"msg_type": "text", "content": {"text": text}},
                        timeout=30,
                    )
                    resp.raise_for_status()

            detail["status"] = "sent"
            result["sent"] += 1
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("负责人推送失败 owner=%s", msg["owner"])
            detail["status"] = f"error:{e}"
        result["details"].append(detail)

    return result

    app: str,
    table: str,

) -> str | None:

    by_name = {f.get("field_name"): f for f in fields}

    print(f"  OK field_id={fid}")
    return fid

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="异常任务指标语义字段")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--backfill",

    try:
        with FeishuClient(settings) as client:

            for name in NEW_FIELDS:

        ]

    fixed = 0
    for t in tasks:
        payload = t.get("payload_json")
        if isinstance(payload, str) and payload:
            try:
                payload = json.loads(payload)

                payload = {}
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):

        changed = False
        for k in (
            "current_label",
            "baseline_label",
            "change_label",
            "value_summary",
            "message",
        ):
            if not t.get(k) and payload.get(k):
                t[k] = payload[k]
                changed = True
        if changed:
            db.upsert_task(t)
            fixed += 1
    print(f"从 payload 补齐本地列: {fixed}")

    # 预览
    for t in tasks[:5]:
        print(
            " sample:",

            "|",
            task_to_fields(t).get("说明"),
        )

    n = write_tasks_to_feishu(tasks, settings=settings)
    print(f"飞书写入任务 {n} 条")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""给飞书「异常任务」表补指标语义字段（幂等），并可选回填现有任务。

新增字段：
  - 当前值含义 / 对比值含义 / 变化幅度含义
  - 指标摘要
（「说明」字段已存在则写入规则文案）

用法：
  python scripts/add_task_metric_fields.py
  python scripts/add_task_metric_fields.py --backfill   # 重算本地任务语义并写回飞书
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient, FeishuError
from app.config import get_settings
from app.rules.engine import evaluate_rows
from app.rules.tasks import apply_anomalies_to_tasks
from app.store.db import Database
from app.sync.feishu_schema import T_TEXT, task_to_fields
from app.sync.writer import write_tasks_to_feishu
from app.config import load_rules_config


NEW_FIELDS = [
    "当前值含义",
    "对比值含义",
    "变化幅度含义",
    "指标摘要",
]


def _ensure_text_field(
    client: FeishuClient,
    app: str,
    table: str,
    field_name: str,
) -> str | None:
    fields = client.list_fields(app, table)
    by_name = {f.get("field_name"): f for f in fields}
    if field_name in by_name:
        fid = by_name[field_name].get("field_id")
        print(f"  exists: {field_name} -> {fid}")
        return fid
    print(f"  create: {field_name} ...")
    data = client.create_field(app, table, field_name, T_TEXT)
    fid = data.get("field_id") or (data.get("field") or {}).get("field_id")
    print(f"  OK field_id={fid}")
    return fid


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="异常任务指标语义字段")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--backfill",
        action="store_true",
        help="按本地 asin_daily 重跑规则并写回飞书任务",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--date", default="", help="回填业务日 YYYY-MM-DD，默认取任务最新日")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.has_feishu or not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token:
        print("ERROR: 需要 FEISHU_APP_ID/SECRET 与 FEISHU_BITABLE_APP_TOKEN")
        return 2
    table = settings.feishu_table_tasks
    if not table:
        print("ERROR: 未配置 FEISHU_TABLE_TASKS")
        return 2
    app = settings.feishu_bitable_app_token

    try:
        with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
            print(f"异常任务表 {table}: 确保语义字段 ...")
            for name in NEW_FIELDS:
                _ensure_text_field(client, app, table, name)
            # 说明字段若缺失也补上
            _ensure_text_field(client, app, table, "说明")
    except FeishuError as e:
        print(f"飞书字段失败: {e}")
        return 1

    if not args.backfill:
        print("字段就绪。需要刷新任务内容请加 --backfill")
        return 0

    db = Database(settings.db_path)
    biz_date = args.date.strip()
    if not biz_date:
        with db.connect() as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT biz_date FROM anomaly_tasks ORDER BY biz_date DESC LIMIT 1"
            ).fetchone()
            biz_date = row["biz_date"] if row else ""
    if not biz_date:
        print("无任务可回填")
        return 0

    print(f"回填业务日 {biz_date} ...")
    rows = db.list_asin_daily(biz_date)
    if not rows:
        print("当日无 asin_daily，跳过规则重算，仅用已有 payload 写飞书")
        tasks = [
            t
            for t in db.list_tasks()
            if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")
        ]
    else:
        rules = load_rules_config()
        anomalies = evaluate_rows(rows, rules)
        stats = apply_anomalies_to_tasks(
            anomalies, biz_date=biz_date, db=db, rules_cfg=rules
        )
        print("rules stats:", stats)
        tasks = [
            t
            for t in db.list_tasks()
            if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")
        ]

    # 从 payload 补齐缺失的语义列（旧任务）
    fixed = 0
    for t in tasks:
        payload = t.get("payload_json")
        if isinstance(payload, str) and payload:
            try:
                payload = json.loads(payload)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                payload = {}
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            continue
        changed = False
        for k in (
            "current_label",
            "baseline_label",
            "change_label",
            "value_summary",
            "message",
        ):
            if not t.get(k) and payload.get(k):
                t[k] = payload[k]
                changed = True
        if changed:
            db.upsert_task(t)
            fixed += 1
    print(f"从 payload 补齐本地列: {fixed}")

    # 预览
    for t in tasks[:5]:
        print(
            " sample:",
            t.get("task_id"),
            t.get("anomaly_type"),
            task_to_fields(t).get("指标摘要"),
            "|",
            task_to_fields(t).get("说明"),
        )

    n = write_tasks_to_feishu(tasks, settings=settings)
    print(f"飞书写入任务 {n} 条")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

            biz_date = row["biz_date"] if row else ""
    if not biz_date:
        print("无任务可回填")
        return 0

    print(f"回填业务日 {biz_date} ...")
    rows = db.list_asin_daily(biz_date)
    if not rows:
        print("当日无 asin_daily，跳过规则重算，仅用已有 payload 写飞书")
        tasks = [
            t
            for t in db.list_tasks()
            if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")
        ]
    else:
        rules = load_rules_config()
        anomalies = evaluate_rows(rows, rules)
        stats = apply_anomalies_to_tasks(
            anomalies, biz_date=biz_date, db=db, rules_cfg=rules
        )
        print("rules stats:", stats)
        tasks = [
            t
            for t in db.list_tasks()
            if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")
        ]

    # 从 payload 补齐缺失的语义列（旧任务）
    fixed = 0
    for t in tasks:
        payload = t.get("payload_json")
        if isinstance(payload, str) and payload:
            try:
                payload = json.loads(payload)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                payload = {}
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            continue
        changed = False
        for k in (
            "current_label",
            "baseline_label",
            "change_label",
            "value_summary",
            "message",
        ):
            if not t.get(k) and payload.get(k):
                t[k] = payload[k]
                changed = True
        if changed:
            db.upsert_task(t)
            fixed += 1
    print(f"从 payload 补齐本地列: {fixed}")

    # 预览
    for t in tasks[:5]:
        print(
            " sample:",
            t.get("task_id"),
            t.get("anomaly_type"),
            task_to_fields(t).get("指标摘要"),
            "|",
            task_to_fields(t).get("说明"),
        )

    n = write_tasks_to_feishu(tasks, settings=settings)
    print(f"飞书写入任务 {n} 条")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from app.notify.owner_push import build_owner_messages
from app.sync.feishu_schema import action_pk_for_task, action_shell_from_task


def test_action_shell_is_pending_for_owner():
    task = {
        "task_id": "T20260721-abc",
        "biz_date": "2026-07-21",
        "shop_name": "特米-UK",
        "asin": "B0TEST",
        "product_title": "English Title",
        "product_title_cn": "G4 20W",
        "anomaly_type": "sales_drop",
        "level": "red",
        "owner": "潘启豪",
        "status": "open",
    }
    shell = action_shell_from_task(task)
    assert shell["主键"] == action_pk_for_task("T20260721-abc")
    assert shell["关联异常编号"] == "T20260721-abc"
    assert shell["店铺"] == "特米-UK"
    assert shell["ASIN"] == "B0TEST"
    assert shell["中文名称"] == "G4 20W"
    assert shell["执行人"] == "潘启豪"
    assert shell["闭环状态"] == "待核实"
    assert shell["是否属实"] == "待核实"
    # 负责人补全字段不由系统写死成有效结论
    assert "原因" not in shell or not shell.get("原因")
    assert "采取动作" not in shell or not shell.get("采取动作")


def test_build_owner_messages_groups_by_owner():
    tasks = [
        {
            "task_id": "T1",
            "shop_name": "特米-UK",
            "asin": "A1",
            "level": "red",
            "anomaly_type": "sales_drop",
            "owner": "潘启豪",
            "status": "open",
            "product_title_cn": "灯珠",
        },
        {
            "task_id": "T2",
            "shop_name": "字同道合",
            "asin": "A2",
            "level": "orange",
            "anomaly_type": "inventory_low",
            "owner": "梦晴",
            "status": "open",
        },
        {
            "task_id": "T3",
            "shop_name": "x",
            "asin": "A3",
            "level": "yellow",
            "anomaly_type": "sales_drop",
            "owner": "梦晴",
            "status": "open",
        },
    ]
    msgs = build_owner_messages(tasks, biz_date="2026-07-21")
    owners = {m["owner"] for m in msgs}
    assert owners == {"潘启豪", "梦晴"}
    pan = next(m for m in msgs if m["owner"] == "潘启豪")
    assert pan["red"] == 1 and pan["orange"] == 0
    assert "T1" in pan["text"]
    assert "待你处理" in pan["text"]

def write_tasks_to_feishu(
    tasks: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
) -> int:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    table_id = settings.feishu_table_tasks
    if not settings.has_feishu or not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token or not table_id:
        logger.warning("飞书任务表未配置，跳过任务同步")
        return 0

    def to_fields(t: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        fields = task_to_fields(t)
        fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if v is not None}
        # 不向 upsert 写 type=18 关联字段（由 backfill 维护）
        fields.pop("关联运营动作", None)

    return int(stats.get("mother") or 0)
